title: Detailed pear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x='47' y='8' width='4' height='14' rx='2' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- Stem highlight -->
  <rect x='48' y='9' width='1.5' height='11' rx='0.75' fill='#B07D56'/>
  <!-- Small leaf -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='12' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#4CAF50' transform='rotate(-25 57 12)'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='12' rx='4' ry='1.8' fill='#66BB6A' transform='rotate(-25 57 12)'/>
  <!-- Leaf vein -->
  <line x1='51' y1='14' x2='63' y2='10' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- Pear main body -->
  <path d='M50 22 
           C46 22 40 26 39 32 
           C38 38 40 43 42 46 
           C44 49 43 53 38 58 
           C32 64 29 70 30 76 
           C31 84 40 90 50 90 
           C60 90 69 84 70 76 
           C71 70 68 64 62 58 
           C57 53 56 49 58 46 
           C60 43 62 38 61 32 
           C60 26 54 22 50 22 Z' 
        fill='#C5D86D'/>
  <!-- Pear shading left -->
  <path d='M50 22 
           C46 22 40 26 39 32 
           C38 38 40 43 42 46 
           C44 49 43 53 38 58 
           C32 64 29 70 30 76 
           C31 84 40 90 50 90 
           L50 22 Z' 
        fill='#A8BE4A' opacity='0.5'/>

  <path d='M50 22 
           C54 22 60 26 61 32 
           C62 38 60 43 58 46 
           C56 49 57 53 62 58 
           C68 64 71 70 70 76 
           C69 84 60 90 50 90 
           L50 22 Z' 
        fill='#D4E388' opacity='0.4'/>

  <ellipse cx='38' cy='72' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#E8A87C' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Blush on right cheek -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='72' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#E8A87C' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Belly lighter area -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#E2ED9A' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- Small dots for texture -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='55' r='0.8' fill='#8FA030'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='52' r='0.8' fill='#8FA030'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='65' r='0.8' fill='#8FA030'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='80' r='0.8' fill='#8FA030'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='78' r='0.8' fill='#8FA030'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='68' r='0.8' fill='#8FA030'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='62' r='0.8' fill='#8FA030'/>
  <!-- Highlight streak -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='40' rx='3' ry='7' fill='#F0F5C0' opacity='0.4' transform='rotate(15 44 40)'/>
